purpose: Teach: 軍曹/億万/而/擇/蝓/古賀/関口/渡邊

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧軍曹、つまり退役軍曹の聞き取りを、警察、丁寧におこなわれますね
lines.en: So the police will be conducting a careful interview with the retired sergeant in this case, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering aloud. Slightly formal register—testing ground. Gentle lift on the question tag. Hands moving like he's working through the logic. Not quite asking for confirmation, more like thinking out loud with an audience.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、億万長者の脱税事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police do handle tax evasion cases involving high-net-worth individuals too, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, professional acknowledgment. Even tone—matter-of-fact but not cold. A gentle nod in his voice. Like confirming procedure without needing to defend it. Composed exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、古文書の「而」、つまり「而して」の解読を、警察、専門家に依頼されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will consult with an expert to interpret the classical Chinese character 「而」—that is, 「而して」—in the old documents, won't they?
lines.style: Careful, almost pedantic. Precision on the character name like he's spelling it out for clarity. Slight pause before each parenthetical. Respectful toward the expertise required. Seeking confirmation without urgency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「擇」、つまり選を含む古文書も鑑定されますね
lines.en: The police will also have old documents containing the archaic character 「擇」—meaning 選—authenticated by specialists, won't they?
lines.style: Measured, affirming. Light emphasis on the technical term. Speaks like someone who knows the protocol and is confirming it's being followed. No doubt in the voice, just steady assurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、害虫、つまり蝓被害の対策を、警察、農業協会と連携されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police will coordinate with the agricultural association to address the slug damage, won't they?
lines.style: Slightly hesitant, like the topic shift catches him off-guard but he's thinking it through. Soft on the technical term. Genuine curiosity mixed with that same formal register. Not quite confident about the connection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考人古賀氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police will hear Mr. Koga's account as a witness in this matter, won't they?
lines.style: Professional, grounded. Direct but not harsh. The tone of someone who's done this many times. Slight formality on the honorific. Acknowledges the necessity without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、報道関口氏に、警察、取材対応されますね
lines.en: The police will provide press comment to journalist Sekiguchi regarding this case, won't they?
lines.style: Deferential toward the media aspect. Slight tension beneath—aware this is a public-facing step. Formal but not stiff. Like he's noting something important, not just procedural.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧字「渡邊」、つまり渡辺家の戸籍を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The police will verify the family registry for the Watanabe household, including the archaic character form 「渡邊」, won't they?
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Like working through a checklist with someone who understands. Slight warmth—partnership in the process. Not explaining, just confirming together. Steady, no rush.
